reading.title: Good News From the Coach
reading.intro_zh: 这篇短文不复述 Mr. Harmsworth 和 salary，而是换到校队办公室：学生被叫去见 coach，以为会被换下，结果得到 junior captain 的好消息。重点回收 secretary、nervous、weak voice、interrupt、could not afford、my turn had come、extra 和 good news。
passage: On Friday afternoon, the school secretary told me that Coach Lin would see me after practice. I felt very nervous when I went into her office. She did not look up from a pile of forms. After I had sat down, she said that the team budget was very small and the club could not afford to send everyone to the city match. Three students had already left the team. I thought my turn had come. "Coach Lin," I said in a weak voice, but she raised a hand. "Don't interrupt," she said. Then she smiled and told me the good news: I would receive an extra responsibility as junior captain for the city match.

questions.question: Why did the narrator go to Coach Lin's office?
options: The school secretary said that Coach Lin would see the narrator after practice.
The narrator wanted to borrow a pile of forms.
Coach Lin asked everyone to clean the gym.
The team had already left for the city match.
questions.explanation_zh: 开头说 the school secretary told me that Coach Lin would see me after practice，所以主人公去了教练办公室。

questions.question: Why did the narrator feel nervous?
options: Because the office was too noisy.
Because Coach Lin looked serious and did not look up from her forms.
Because the narrator had never played in a match before.
Because the secretary forgot the narrator's name.
questions.explanation_zh: 主人公进办公室时很紧张，Coach Lin 还一直低头看表格，这让气氛更像坏消息。

questions.question: Which details made the news sound bad at first?
options: The coach smiled and gave the narrator a prize.
The secretary invited the whole team to a party.
The budget was small, the club could not afford to send everyone, and three students had left.
The city match had already been won.
questions.explanation_zh: small budget、could not afford to send everyone、three students had already left 都让主人公以为坏消息要来了。

questions.question: What showed that the narrator was afraid?
options: The narrator shouted happily.
The narrator left the office at once.
The narrator read all the forms carefully.
The narrator spoke in a weak voice and was stopped by "Don't interrupt."
questions.explanation_zh: 文中说 I said in a weak voice，接着教练说 Don't interrupt，说明主人公想解释或求情，很害怕。

questions.question: What was the real good news?
options: The narrator would leave the team.
The narrator would receive an extra responsibility as junior captain.
The club would cancel the city match.
The secretary would become the new coach.
questions.explanation_zh: 结尾反转：Coach Lin smiled，并告诉主人公会成为 city match 的 junior captain。

writing.intro_zh: 今天抓 Lesson 15 的五个核心句式：用 told me that...would... 转述过去说的未来安排，用 felt very nervous when... 写紧张时刻，用 did not look up from... 制造严肃气氛，用 could not afford to... 说明资源不够，最后用 Then he smiled and told me... 写好消息反转。

patterns.title: told me that ... would ...
patterns.source: The secretary told me that Mr. Harmsworth would see me.
patterns.focus_zh: 用 told me that...would... 转述别人过去告诉你的未来安排，特别适合写通知、约谈或消息。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写老师、班长、教练或家长告诉你，某个人稍后会见你或找你谈话。
patterns.sample: The monitor told me that our teacher would see me after class.
patterns.tip_zh: told 是过去的通知；would 表示当时看来还没有发生的安排。

patterns.title: felt very nervous when ...
patterns.source: I felt very nervous when I went into his office.
patterns.focus_zh: 这个句式把情绪和触发它的时刻连在一起，让读者马上进入主人公的心理。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写你走进办公室、考场、比赛场或老师面前时很紧张。
patterns.sample: I felt very nervous when I walked into the music room.
patterns.tip_zh: when 后面写具体场景，不要只写 a thing；画面越具体，紧张感越清楚。

patterns.title: did not look up from ...
patterns.source: He did not look up from his desk when I entered.
patterns.focus_zh: did not look up from... 可以写一个人继续低头做事，制造严肃、冷静或紧张的气氛。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写老师、教练、家长或工作人员在你进来时没有从某样东西上抬头。
patterns.sample: My coach did not look up from her notebook when I entered.
patterns.tip_zh: from 后面接 desk, book, notebook, forms, screen 等具体物品。

patterns.title: could not afford to ...
patterns.source: The firm could not afford to pay such large salaries.
patterns.focus_zh: could not afford to... 表示没有足够的钱、时间或资源去做某事。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写一个团队、家庭、社团或学校因为资源不够，做不了某件事。
patterns.sample: Our club could not afford to buy new uniforms this year.
patterns.tip_zh: afford 后面接 to do；这里不一定只讲钱，也可以讲时间、空间或资源。

patterns.title: Then he smiled and told me ...
patterns.source: Then he smiled and told me I would receive an extra thousand pounds a year!
patterns.focus_zh: 这个句式适合放在故事结尾：前面一直像坏消息，smiled 之后才揭示真正的好消息。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写一个人先显得很严肃，最后微笑着告诉你一个表扬、机会或奖励。
must_include: Then he smiled and told me
patterns.sample: Then he smiled and told me I would lead the next group project.
patterns.tip_zh: 如果主语不是 he，可以先练原句结构；熟了以后再换成 she / my teacher。
